BiblicalUsage: Pedahzur is named only as the father of Gamaliel, prince of Manasseh. His son offered on the eighth day at the dedication of the altar, and led the host of Manasseh when the camp set out from Sinai.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that a father's name lives on in his son's faithfulness, and Pedahzur is remembered because Gamaliel stood in his place before God and before Israel.
